scenicChapters.title: Hanno fuel gate → Chichibu green line
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 36 km. 620 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Chichibu green line → Nagatoro river stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 22 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

tokyo-chichibu-green-line.storyWas: Forest ridge roads and tight bends west of the city.
